reviews_captured_by_me.text: Gail designed our kitchen when we remodled our 90 year old mill house. I had no idea my kitchen could be so wonderful! I thought we would just replace the old cabinets in the same layout but Gail was able to redesign the space and give me so much more working room and storage. She gave me several options to choose from and we couldn't be happier with the outcome! I would recommend her design skills to anyone!
Gail and Sam were wonderful to work with.  They know what they are doing.  I highly recommend their service.
